intent: Hold the best-raced geometry unchanged (±0.03 m row at 16 mm, y = 0.04, wheels, body and mass as before) so the Integrator's kp 1.2 / kd 0.4 controller is judged on the platform it was tuned for. I am not expecting a new best score from this race. Next iteration I plan to race the ±0.04 m row at 16 mm, y = 0.04, with kp 1.2 and kd 0.4, which tests the widening on its own. If that row still leaves line loss at 1.0 or more per run, the 12 mm footprint at the same ±0.04 m spacing is the next test.
learning: Open hypotheses: (1) confirmed-gain hypothesis: a score near 69.46 at kp 1.2 confirms that iteration 4's drop was the gain change, not the ±0.04 m row; (2) if the ±0.04 m row at kp 1.2 gives more progress than 0.210 on the s-bend with line loss below 1.0, the wider coverage edge helps; (3) if line loss stays at 1.0 or more with the wider row, 16 mm edge noise may be the cause, and the 12 mm test at the same spacing is the discriminator. Please report, in integration feedback, the progress at the first line-loss event on each track, the max error at that moment, and whether the loss happens at start-up.
rationale:
The evidence in the race history is consistent. The best raced design is the ±0.03 m row at 16 mm with y = 0.04 (iteration 3, score 69.46). Iteration 5 reproduced that score exactly, and iteration 6 at kp 1.2 also scored 69.46. Every run still ends off track at max error about 0.062 m, against the 0.06 m limit. Body width cannot relax that limit inside the allowed range, so the limit is the binding failure. Line loss persists at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run on all tracks.

Iteration 4 widened the row to ±0.04 m and cut kp from 1.2 to 1.0 in the same race. Progress fell on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170), and line loss did not improve. The Integrator's current feedback reads that as mainly a gain effect, and has restored kp 1.2 and kd 0.4 on the ±0.03 row. It asks that this race hold ±0.03 m so the controller is judged on the geometry it was tuned for. I am following that request. Changing the row now would confound the controller with a geometry change.

The ±0.04 m row at kp 1.2 is still the one untested geometry question, and it is the next test. I am not repeating that test this iteration, because the Integrator asked for the hold and the result is already known to be 69.46 on this geometry. I am not committing to a forward offset, since slalom oscillation (0.145 to 0.147) is still below the 0.15 trigger. Expected result: about 69.46, with max error near 0.062 m and line loss at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run.
